title: A pattern within both figures is not refused for its counted quantifiers
description: (a{10}){10} has bounds of 10 and a nested product of 100, and ((){100}){100} a product of 10,000: both are within 65,535 and 1,000,000, so neither is refused. A hundred a's match the first, and the empty subject matches the second, whose ten thousand idle iterations are far below the least match-cost limit a processor has by default.
